[SWS_CanNm_00285] ⌈Caveats of CanNm_RxIndication:
• Until this service returns the CAN Interface will not access canSduPtr. The can
SduPtr is only valid and can be used by upper layers until the indication returns.
CAN Interface guarantees that the number of configured bytes for this CanNm-
RxPduId is valid. The call context is either on interrupt level (interrupt mode) or
on task level (polling mode). This callback service is re-entrant for multiple CAN
controller usage.
